### Transcendence (only possible with our approach)

| # | Feature | Command | Buildability | Score | Why Only We Can Do This |
|---|---------|---------|--------------|-------|-------------------------|
| 1 | Lien-chain reconstruction | `lien-chain --folio <folio>` | hand-code | 10/10 | Requires local join across deeds (Property index) and per-grantee Name-search results filtered by subdivision+plat+block signature; no single endpoint produces this |
| 2 | Surviving-liens calculator | `surviving-liens --folio <folio>` | hand-code | 10/10 | Requires pairing every lien (MOR/LIE/FTL/JUD/LIS) against its release (SAT/REL by `linK_DOCTYPE`) + static FL-survivability table (FTL survives TD; HOA capped per FL Stat 720/718); pure local DB logic |
| 3 | Chain of title | `chain-of-title --folio <folio> [--since YYYY-MM-DD]` | hand-code | 9/10 | Local SQLite query on deed-type recordings ordered by date, with gap detection across grantor↔next-grantee transitions; no API call returns this assembled view |
| 4 | Owner portfolio scan | `owner-portfolio --name "<owner>"` | hand-code | 8/10 | Single Name search → entity-centric three-bucket grouping (folios on, mortgages taken, lis pendens/judgments against) — agent-shaped lead-gen + risk output |
| 5 | Litigation arc tracker | `case-arc --case <case-number>` | hand-code | 7/10 | Mechanical doc-type sequence walker (LIS→JUD→CTI→...) per court case across all recording dates; portal exposes the data but not the arc |
| 6 | Folio-batch enrichment | `enrich --folio-list folios.csv [--out lien-summary.json]` | hand-code | 9/10 | Orchestrator of #1+#2+#3 over a list; emits Supabase-ingest-ready JSON (cents, ISO dates, stable `cfn_master_id`) |
| 7 | FTL hot-list | `ftl-scan --since YYYY-MM-DD [--folio-list folios.csv]` | hand-code | 7/10 | Filter on `doc_type_code='FTL'` post-date, joined to a folio watchlist; v3 `uw_td_govt_liens` column today has no upstream feed |
| 8 | Document downloader | `download-pdf <cfn_master_id> [--out ./pdfs]` | spec-emits | 6/10 | Resolves per-record viewer URL → fetches scanned PDF via Surf transport using the same browser-clearance session as the search endpoints |

**Hand-code commitment:** 7 features (lien-chain, surviving-liens, chain-of-title, owner-portfolio, case-arc, enrich, ftl-scan) require hand-written Cobra files plus `root.go` wiring after `printing-press generate` — ~50-150 LoC each. 1 feature (download-pdf) is `spec-emits` and the generator handles it.

## Customer model (from Phase 1.5c.5 subagent)

- **Alex Kleis (BlueStone)** — Foreclosure investor preparing Tue auction bids. Weekly ritual: lien-due-diligence sweep on 30+ properties. Frustration: deed-walking + per-owner name-searches = 20-40 clicks/property.
- **Sarah** — Title underwriter at small Miami firm. Weekly ritual: 15-30 O&E reports. Frustration: vendor cost ($20-50/property) or fall back to free portal's same 20-40-click ordeal.
- **v3 frontend AI underwriter** — Automated downstream consumer. Needs cents, ISO-8601, stable `cfn_master_id`, viewer URL. Currently has `uw_td_govt_liens` column with no upstream feed.
